reason: I'd take the free listing, why not, but my promotions and bookings already run on Instagram and WhatsApp for nothing, and half my summer guests are tourists who come once, so a loyalty loop for regulars doesn't pay me 59 lari plus another payment fee on top of my terminal.
objection: Another transaction fee on top of what I already pay my bank, and a new system my waiters have to explain to guests, for reviews and loyalty I mostly get from Instagram already.
would_change_my_mind: If the payment fee was lower than my current terminal and I could see after the free months that it actually brought regulars back or got us better ratings than Google and Instagram do.
